title: Exploring Widower's Nest
description: Exploring Widower's Nest — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Loremaster Vraile

Quest Type: Explore

Quest Description: Explore many locations connected to Widower's Nest and return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston. Involves visiting the locations: Ruins of Castle Caninenstein, Maerz Catacombs of Doom, Doug's Digsite, Tomb of the Ice Climber, and Xhelduh's Hideout.

Quest Reward: 5000 Gold

Return to: Loremaster Vraile in Townston

Repeatable: No
